notes.title: [Solved] DLC Installation problems
notes.notes:
Greetings,
 
We’ve been made aware of issues with Escape Game Fort Boyard’s DLC, as some players could not access it after their purchase.
This technical problem is now resolved, and all players should now access the DLC’s new content.
We sincerely apologize about this issue, and hope you’ll enjoy the new trials.
 
The Microids Team
